securityVerdict: Conditionally approved for optional, consent-gated local use only.

auditSummary.dynamicInstall: fresh temporary virtualenv with blank HOME; Docker unavailable

hivemindAdaptations: Wraps the upstream scraper as an optional skill instead of auto-installing it.
Pins the audited upstream commit and records a deterministic source archive hash.
Adds explicit consent gates for install, Playwright Chromium download, browser automation, scraping volume, and output handling.
Forbids use of personal browser profiles, cookies, keychains, shared env, SSH files, cloud CLIs, wallet data, proxies, CAPTCHA solving, or unattended broad scraping.
Documents the Windows PowerShell shortcut helper as opt-in only.
